statement: The ANC finishes below 35.0 percent of the national vote in the South African local government elections held on 2026-11-04, per IEC results declared between 2026-11-05 and 2026-11-11.
resolution: TRUE if IEC final results declared between 2026-11-05 and 2026-11-11 show the ANC below 35.0 percent of the national valid vote; FALSE at 35.0 or above.
failure_condition: The declared national ANC share is 35.0 percent or higher, or no national declaration is made inside the window.

control_basis.rule: climatological, trailing - the realized hit rate of the mirrored arm's own resolved rows, by the first step of the ladder with at least 10 rows (registration v4, Section 3)
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. The floor the mirrored arm must clear, priced from its own record; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: CISA adds at least one SonicWall vulnerability to the KEV catalog between 2026-11-05 and 2027-01-29.
resolution: TRUE if the CISA KEV catalog carries a date-added value between 2026-11-05 and 2027-01-29 for at least one entry with vendor SonicWall.
failure_condition: No SonicWall entry in the KEV catalog has a date-added value inside the window.

statement: The UK Supreme Court hands down judgment in the Ammori appeal against the proscription of Palestine Action between 2026-11-06 and 2027-01-29.
resolution: TRUE if the UK Supreme Court case page for UKSC/2026/0099 records a judgment handed down between 2026-11-06 and 2027-01-29, whichever side prevails.
failure_condition: The Supreme Court has not delivered its judgment inside the window.
